meta.name: prisma-postgres-setup
meta.description: Set up a new Prisma Postgres database and connect it to a local project using the Management API. Use when asked to "set up a database", "create a Prisma Postgres project", "get a connection string", "connect my app to Prisma Postgres", or "provision a database".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 开通数据库并接入本地项目
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在本地项目中快速接入一个 Postgres 数据库。
copy.tagline_en: Set up a Postgres database for your local project.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a Postgres database connected to your local project quickly.

howto.what: 它会引导你新建一个 Prisma Postgres 云数据库并连接到本地项目,包括选择区域、创建数据库、安装依赖、写入连接串、生成客户端并验证连接。
howto.when: 当你说“set up a database”、“create a Prisma Postgres project”等,或要求“provision a database”时触发。

say.text: 帮我设置一个新的 Prisma Postgres 数据库
say.note: 它会列出可选的区域让你挑。

say.text: 给我一个连接字符串,并配置到本地项目
say.note: 它会创建项目并把连接串写入 .env。

say.text: 为我的项目创建数据库并初始化迁移
say.note: 它会生成初始 schema 并执行迁移。

howto.what_en: Guides you through creating a new Prisma Postgres database via the Management API and connecting it to a local project: region selection, database creation, dependencies, connection string, client generation, and verification.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to set up a database, create a Prisma Postgres project, get a connection string, etc.

say_en.text: Set up a new Prisma Postgres database for me.
say_en.note: It will list regions and ask you to pick one.

say_en.text: Give me a connection string and configure it in my project.
say_en.note: It will create the project and write the string to .env.

say_en.text: Create a database for my project and run the initial migration.
say_en.note: It will generate a starter schema and run migrate dev.
